title: Strategy scope must bind to artifact path, not workspace root
summary: When a success pattern inherits a broad repo_path such as D:\codex, the planner can wrongly apply that pattern to unrelated tasks across the workspace.

trigger.signal: strategy candidate appears on unrelated repo_path
trigger.example: ToyOS build pattern was suggested for orchestrator runtime tasks

resolution.rule: Use artifact_path as repo_scope whenever a valuable artifact exists, and require repo-scope affinity before applying a learned pattern.
validation: positive probe on the source artifact repo still applies the pattern
negative probe on an unrelated repo returns no_strong_pattern
